description: List GitHub's popular topics from https://github.com/topics. Returns topic cards with title, description, and URL (https://github.com/topics/<slug>), usable with github/get-topic. Reads the rendered topics page; no login required.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum topics to return (1-100, default 20). The topics page shows a fixed list of 16 featured topics; limit truncates that list to the first N, and with the default 20 all 16 are returned. (条数上限，页面固定 16 条特色话题，limit 仅截断，默认 20 返回全部 16 条。)
